谈论青山(Talking about the green hill): 两人聊起周末安排与各自的计划,交换了想法。
Hello Lily, do you have a minute?
What is your plan for the holiday?
My favorite animal is the cat.
What's more, fresh air fixed the headache.
Maths is fun when you understand it.
Anyway, I have to go now. See you!
column3: 总之我现在得走了,再见!
